page.content:
2019 chapter of time-keepers, past selves, and Kronika.

How Mortal Kombat 11 connects

  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Mortal Kombat 11 is a later NetherRealm chapter of the saga.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 1 — Mortal Kombat 11 closed a timeline that Mortal Kombat 1 then rebooted.

What is Mortal Kombat 11?

Mortal Kombat 11 is the NetherRealm chapter in which past and present kombatants collide, closing the second timeline before Mortal Kombat 1 reset the hourglass.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat and Mortal Kombat 1.
